item.title: 260,000 cleared their public debt in one year
item.description: According to a report by Denmark’s Debt Collection Agency (Gældsstyrelsen), 260,000 citizens have cleared their public debt within a year. By June 30, 2025, about 500,000 citizens still owed a total of roughly 108 billion kroner. Rudersdal Municipality residents had the highest average debt at 470,000 kroner, while Fanø Municipality had the lowest on average […]

item.title: Government expands deportation reform with GPS ankle bracelet plan
item.description: The Danish government plans to introduce electronic monitoring for foreign nationals with criminal records who are staying at departure centres, as part of its upcoming deportation reform.

item.title: Greenlanders look to Europe, not the U.S.
item.description: Despite political and business discussions about closer ties with the United States, public opinion in Greenland strongly favours deeper cooperation with the European Union.

item.title: Nykredit joins housing market price war
item.description: Totalkredit, owned by Nykredit, is reducing the price for having a fixed-rate loan without repayment. Specifically, the surcharge for repayment freedom is being lowered. This change, effective April 1st, allows both new and existing customers access to reduced contribution rates. The total rate for an 80% loan-to-value mortgage without repayment decreases from 0.81% to 0.72%. […]
